title: Circles
text: {who} found the footage of the Choir's tenders on the shared screen and hasn't looked away since. "They walk in circles round a dead tower. For how long?" A pause. "Is that what happens to your kind, when nobody needs you any more?"

choices.label: "I don't know."
choices.reply: "Then we'd better keep needing you," {who} says, and almost makes it sound like a joke.

choices.label: "They still have each other."
choices.reply: {who} thinks about that for a long time. "That's worse, somehow. Or better. I can't tell."

notes: A colonist at home reacts by name once the-choir is done (the discovery played back at home, v0.90.0).
